title: DNA Extraction from Broth
author: Christopher Duda
materials: Promega Maxwell RSC cultured kit
Rappaport-Vassiliadis Broth
Tetrathionate broth
LE-Lysozyme
Metapolyzyme
70% Ethanol
Centrifuge
Pipettes
Microcentrifuge tubes
Elution Buffer Tube and Lid positioning
In the RSC Software, press Start to access the extraction method selection screen.
Select Cultured Cells DNA method, then press Proceed .

Select the lanes being used by touching them. Sample names can be inputted at this time. Note: For the RSC48, press the "BACK" and "FRONT" buttons on the bottom of the screen to move to each respective rack.
Press Proceed to continue. The instrument door will open.

Install the deck tray(s) into the platform by angling the back of the tray and inserting first. Press down the front of the tray until it snaps into place. Ensure the deck tray is level and fully seated. Note: For the RSC48, ensure the tray labelled FRONT and BACK are placed in the correct places in the instrument.
Verify that all of the cartridges are properly inserted into the tray, the elution tubes are present and uncapped, and then plungers are in Well
Note: Ensure there are no old plungers left on the instrument from a prior run.
Press Start to begin the extraction run.
Follow on-screen instructions at the end of the run.
Remove the deck tray(s) from the instrument. The DNA can be transferred to 1.5 ml LoBind Tubes for storage.
Remove the cartridges and plungers from the deck trays and discard in a biohazard container.
Clean the tray with 70% Ethanol. Do NOT use bleach to clean the trays as this reacts with Guanidine Thiocyanate.
Proceed to the Cleaning and Decontamination steps.
Proceed to quantify the DNA using the DNA Quantification using the Qubit Fluorometer SOP.

Lysis With Metapolyzyme *Only do one lysis step* Resuspend the pellet with 50ul of metapolyzyme (Sigma-aldrich). Vortex for 5-10 seconds Incubate at 37 ºC for at least 30 minutes. If the enrichment contains a highly gram-positive community, an increased lysis time may be necessary. Add 400 μL of the lysate to the first well of the maxwell kit cartridge. Proceed to Cultured Cells DNA Cartridge Preparation
Continue onto EITHER Step 3 or 4.

1. In the RSC Software, press Start to access the extraction method selection screen. 2. Select Cultured Cells DNA method, then press Proceed . 3. Select the lanes being used by touching them. Sample names can be inputted at this time. Note: For the RSC48, press the "BACK" and "FRONT" buttons on the bottom of the screen to move to each respective rack. 4. Press Proceed to continue. The instrument door will open. 5. Install the deck tray(s) into the platform by angling the back of the tray and inserting first. Press down the front of the tray until it snaps into place. Ensure the deck tray is level and fully seated. Note: For the RSC48, ensure the tray labelled FRONT and BACK are placed in the correct places in the instrument. 6. Note: Ensure there are no old plungers left on the instrument from a prior run. 7. Press Start to begin the extraction run. 8. Follow on-screen instructions at the end of the run. 9. Remove the deck tray(s) from the instrument. The DNA can be transferred to 1.5 ml LoBind Tubes for storage. 10. Do NOT use bleach to clean the trays as this reacts with Guanidine Thiocyanate. 12. Proceed to the Cleaning and Decontamination steps. 13. steps.title: Power on instrument and software
steps.instruction: Turn on the Maxwell RSC instrument and the connected PC, start the RSC software, and wait for the instrument to initialize.

steps.title: Open door and load cartridges
steps.instruction: Open the instrument door via the Door icon in the software, remove the deck tray(s), place the required number of cartridges (Well 1 up) into the tray, snap them into position, peel off the entire seal, and add a plunger to Well 8 of each cartridge.

steps.title: Prepare elution tubes
steps.instruction: Insert the supplied elution tubes into the elution‑tube position with the lid facing the bottom of the deck tray, add 100 µL Elution Buffer to each tube, ensuring no bubbles and that the buffer sits at the bottom.

steps.title: Transfer culture to tube
steps.instruction: Transfer at least 8 mL of Rappaport‑Vassiliadis broth (RV), Tetrathionate broth (TT), or any overnight enrichment (mBPW, UPB, TSB, APW) into a 15 mL centrifuge tube.

steps.title: Spin down culture
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tube at 3,000 rcf for 20 minutes, then discard the supernatant.

steps.title: Choose and perform lysis
steps.instruction: Perform ONE of the following lysis methods:

substeps.instruction: Standard Maxwell kit buffer: Remove 400 µL lysis buffer from Well 1 of a cartridge, add the cell pellet, vortex to resuspend, then return the 400 µL mixture to Well 1.
Tetrathionate broth extra salt removal: After resuspending as above, centrifuge at 300 rcf for 3 minutes to pellet solid salts, discard the supernatant, and add the cleared lysate to Well 1.
Lysozyme method: Resuspend the pellet in 400 µL TE‑Lysozyme buffer, vortex 5‑10 seconds, incubate at 37 °C for at least 30 minutes, then add the lysate to Well 1.

steps.title: Add sample to cartridge
steps.instruction: Transfer 400 µL of the prepared sample (or lysate) into the lysis buffer in Well 1 of the corresponding cartridge and pipette up and down 10 times to mix.

steps.title: Optional RNase A treatment
steps.instruction: Allow cells in Well 1 to lyse for 10 minutes, add 2 µL RNase A, pipette to mix, and incubate an additional 10 minutes before starting the instrument.

steps.title: Run extraction on instrument
steps.instruction: Proceed with the instrument setup and start the DNA extraction run according to the Maxwell RSC software.

steps.title: Clean and sterilize instrument
steps.instruction: Wipe the Maxwell RSC instrument with 70 % ethanol as needed, then perform the built‑in sterilization process after each extraction.
